{{Quote|Your Emperor needs you. Your courage. Your skill. Several of our most capable pilot recruiters have been dispatched to educate and inform all citizens of the galaxy who have the mettle to fly for the Empire.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cilas Veckon]]|<ref name="SWG:JTIN" />}}
'''Imperial Navy Recruitment''' was the [[Imperial recruiter|recruitment]] organization of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Space Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|It is a dark time for those who cleave to the pillar principles of the Empire. Without heroic intervention by citizen pilots such as you, this horrid 'rebellion' could prove to be the final undoing of our civilization, our liberty... our very lives. Hired killers have taken aim against the selfless agents of our government, and have threatened to plunge us head-long into anarchy. Moreover, sensing their despicable opportunities in this 'rebellion,' vast armies of corrupt criminal pirates, smugglers, and assassins have banded together to further tear the fabric of Imperial decency.|Admiral Cilas Veckon|<ref name="SWG:JTIN" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Imperial Navy Recruitment office was tasked with recruitment of volunteers to join the Imperial Navy in the fight against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:JTIN" />

As the war intensified after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cilas Veckon]], the Chief of Imperial Navy Recruitment, initiated a large recruitment program of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] for the [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Imperial Starfighter Corps]]. His staff identified skilled [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] throughout the galaxy and sent strongly worded recruitment messages to potential recruits.<ref name="SWG:JTIN" /> Despite the notorious Imperial [[High Human Culture/Legends|anti-alien policy]], all [[Species/Legends|species]] were invited to join the program.<ref name="SWG:AN" /> Admiral Veckon then placed [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]] [[Gunham]], [[Zhanks]] and [[Landau]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], respectively, to oversee major pushes in recruitment.<ref name="SWG:JTIN" /> The recruitment program culminated<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> resulting in a new batch of pilots joining [[Black Epsilon]], [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]] and the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Imperial Inquisition's squadron]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> Although the Imperial Navy recruitment program was a success, the Rebellion and neutral factions soon initiated similar programs that were also very successful.<ref name="SWG:IDN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Imperial Navy Recruitment appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:JTIN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Imperial Navy Recruitment was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:JTIN" />
